answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's earnings unlock linearly over 40 epochs, and an account later proven sybil forfeits its whole unvested balance. A 1,000-puppet farm earning 10 tokens per puppet per epoch carries about 200,000 unvested tokens at steady state, so one exposure erases months of income. Honest agents lose nothing by waiting. Value ripens like an orchard over seasons; a farm at the zenith of its output holds the most unripe fruit, and that opal-bright balance is what it loses.
